defective_pattern: Appending footnote definitions as standard plain text paragraphs in Word docx files.
why_defective: Bypasses OpenXML creation, resulting in documents that lack native footnote behavior (e.g., dynamic numbering, hover text, proper structural linkage).
observed_symptoms: Footnotes appear as literal text at the end of the document.
Absence of 'word/footnotes.xml' in the DOCX archive.
corrective_remedy: Implement mandatory OpenXML footnote injection using native utilities like pack_native_footnotes. Add zip verification in orchestrator gates to ensure word/footnotes.xml exists.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Absence of word/footnotes.xml inside the generated DOCX archive when footnotes are expected, or finding plain text footnote strings at the bottom of document text.
